The vendor portal keeps a record of every change to your listing. It shows what changed, when, and who made the change. When AEC Integrations changes something you hold, it shows our reason.

## Where to find it

In the vendor portal, choose **Changes** in the top row. Every plan has it, Free and Managed alike.

## What each row shows

Each row is one change, newest first. It shows:

- **What happened,** in plain words. For example, "Product listing updated" or "Integration retired".
- **What it was about.** The company, product or integration the change touched, by its current name.
- **When.** The date and time of the change.
- **By.** Who made it: **Your team**, **AECi**, or **System**. System means an automatic process, such as a plan reminder or a contest that closed with no answer.
- **Changed.** The names of the fields that changed, when there were any. The list shows which fields changed, not their old or new values.
- **Plan at the time.** Your plan when the change was made, Free or Managed.

When AEC Integrations changes something you hold, the row can show a **Reason from AECi**. That is the reason we wrote for you. Some of our changes carry no reason for you, and their rows show none.

## Filter the list

Use the buttons above the list:

- **All changes** shows everything.
- **Your team's edits** shows changes a person on your team made from their seat.
- **AECi changes** shows changes an AEC Integrations admin made.

The filter goes by who made the change, not by what changed. If an AECi admin edits your product listing, that row shows under **AECi changes**. Changes made by an automatic process have no person behind them, so they show under **All changes** only.

## Download a copy

Choose **Download CSV** to save the list as a spreadsheet file. It uses the filter you picked. One file holds up to 10,000 rows.

## What the list does not include

The list starts when change history began. Changes made before then are not listed.

The list does not include messages we sent you. Those are under **Messages**.

## Search engines

A change here is a change to your listing on AEC Integrations. Search engines decide when they crawl your pages and what they show in their results. The list makes no promise about search results.

A later update will add, for each change, what we did to tell search engines about the pages it touched.
